says: Final pass on the night city. The moonlight rims now follow the moon: each gourd keeps its white crescent and lighter band only on the side that actually faces it, the right edge of the left tower, the left flank of the big building, the tops of the domes. Small life is added cheaply: three tiny walkers on the bridge, a string of lights swung under its rail, and a second little lit craft hanging between the towers. The headlight beam is a crisp white wedge again, the sky lines stopping cleanly at its two edges.
